title: MedReason-Bench: Clinical LLM Reasoning Evaluation in Cardiology and Autoimmune Disease
description: DRAFT metadata — do not deposit until corpus review completes. MedReason-Bench is a benchmark of 100 hand-written clinical vignettes (50 cardiology, 50 autoimmune) with within-case demographic variants, answer-preserving clinical perturbations, and adversarial unanswerable cases, plus a reproducible evaluation harness measuring accuracy, calibration, hallucination/abstention, robustness, and fairness. This deposit covers corpus v1.0.0 (human-reviewed items only); machine-generated expansion drafts are excluded pending review. No benchmark results are published yet.
